role: Replacement PO with marketing and commercial architecture review

recommendation.decision: Retain99/249monthly price hypotheses and Enterprise quote. Do not publish reduced allowances based only on conservative cost guesses. The explicit75/250minute packages below are a bounded written first-cohort fallback, not a recommended broad retail change or approved replacement for legacy units. Make a complete delivered service and measured affordable customer volume the commercial gate.
recommendation.minimumPaidOutcome: One supported home-service shop receives the owner-selected combination of website intake, AI overflow calls, two-way service texting and owned Google visit sync from one saved profile, then sees the exact request/visit and delivery status. Both packages include the same core capabilities; capacity changes, not invented extra automation. Start as a deliberately funded cohort, not an open-ended mass-market promise.
recommendation.immediateOffer: Continue free setup/private review. The earliest paid candidate is the explicit written bounded cohort offer only after selected real services are ready, period enforcement works, a buyer accepts its value/units and Steve approves the global terms/funding. A website-only99offer does not satisfy the full-service objective.
recommendation.commercialConfidence: Moderate arithmetic confidence conditional on explicit assumptions; low actual-cost, capacity and willingness-to-pay confidence. No observed complete paid-tenant invoice or accepted buyer proposal exists.
recommendation.retailUnitDecision: Do not select a public allowance yet. Current legacy150/600minutes and500/1500logicaltexts are unapproved, and the lower75/250minute fallback loses badly on raw phone volume. The next concrete decision uses measured all-in managed-call/AI/SMS costs and an actual buyer response to a fixed-total proposal; improve costs or revise scope/price rather than selling an uncompetitive cutoff as good value.

sharedScope.included: One business, verified owner, dedicated US local number, optional website/phone/text/Google connections, source-bound answers, customer requests, saved visits, email owner alerts, optional consented appointment messages, request follow-through journal and CSV. Existing free rule editing/exports are not newly claimed as paid-only.
sharedScope.selection: Capabilities can be included without forcing unused connections. Readiness and payment admission check exactly the channels the owner selected; preserve that purchased scope. Adding a channel reuses business facts and completes only its own permission/delivery prerequisites.
sharedScope.notIncluded: Human receptionist labor, automatic owner outbound callbacks, dispatch, native Jobber/Housecall Pro/lead-marketplace integrations, warm transfer, extra locations/staff roles, guaranteed recovered revenue or an SLA. Do not sell these as delivered capabilities.
sharedScope.calendarDecision: This scope syncs visits created here to the selected owned calendar. Other Google events do not currently block workspace availability; the owner must enter unavailable time. Show this at the scheduling decision until conflict integration is delivered.
sharedScope.support: Routine service setup remains automated. Email support and exception resolution are included within a funded internal reserve; no promised response SLA. Personal OAuth approval, legal attestation and carrier forwarding choices remain the customer's one-time actions.
sharedScope.setupFees: Recommend no separate mandatory customer setup/registration charge for this controlled candidate: M&C funds one correct STANDARD registration attempt. Optional specialist work stays separately quoted, unpurchased and outside this offer; no invented industry fee or hidden surcharge.

unitContract.period: Stripe subscription current_period_start/current_period_end, including timezone/date display; reset once by authoritative period identity. No calendar-month proxy, daily reset or offer-version change may replenish monthly capacity.
unitContract.voice: Aggregate elapsed AI-handled seconds divided by60, with actual same-call provider IDs; no rounding every call to a full customer minute. Carrier per-leg rounding/fallback remains M&C cost. Proposed per-call maximum180seconds with a clear end/fallback script. Atomically reserve remaining worst-case duration before starting and reconcile actual once; do not sell reserved minutes as used minutes.
unitContract.AIReplies: One completed final customer reply across website and SMS, not a conversation, tool call or arbitrary token. Voice AI is covered by phone minutes. Private practice has its own included5/10monthly replies. Failed/unknown work retains internal cost reservations until reconciled; do not charge a customer unit for an absent answer or allow unlimited free retries.
unitContract.SMSParts: Outgoing carrier SMS parts across answers, confirmations, reminders and cancellations; display both logical messages and parts. One long text can use several. Inbound texts and STOP/HELP control traffic carry no extra customer charge and use separately funded protective reserves. No MMS/marketing blasts.
unitContract.overages: Zero automatic overage, top-up, add-on, tax surcharge or upgrade charge. At included limits, stop new consuming work safely; preserve requests and show the exact reset/next option. No paid expansion until the owner accepts another explicit supported offer; launch can leave expansion unavailable.
unitContract.warnings: Show used, remaining, reserved/unconfirmed and next reset in Account/Connections; notify at80percent and exhaustion without spending the exhausted SMS allowance. On failure explain saved request versus unconfirmed delivery, never show delivered merely because queued.

costModel.qualification: All rows use every included unit. Exact Decimal arithmetic cross-checked with rational sums. Service contribution is not accounting gross margin, company profit, measured COGS or a guaranteed upper bound.
costModel.fixedAndReserveBasis: Number1.15+STANDARD campaign10monthly.15/shop infrastructure reserve assumes a bounded five-shop cohort, enough75aggregate for modeled Netlify20+Resend20+optional VapiCore29 plus6buffer; these are funding assumptions, not purchased-plan facts. A single early shop requires an explicit startup subsidy, not five-way savings. Support10/20planning and15/30stress are internal labor-dollar assumptions; actual time is unmeasured.
costModel.AIEnvelopeRequired: 0.12USD per completed logical reply is a proposed enforceable reservation, not current average cost. Example route admits at most3physical Opus attempts total, each <=5000input/cache-write tokens and500output tokens; at5USD/M input cache-write and20USD/M output that is0.105USD, leaving0.015buffer. Prompt tokenization must prove this fits without deleting essential rules/tools; SDK retries/fallbacks must consume the same envelope. Otherwise this package fails its cost gate.
costModel.unboundedTails: Provider inbound spam, automatic compliance replies, extreme routing/rounding, registration retries, refunds/disputes, outages and support can exceed planning. Retained-cost/admission guards cannot promise an absolute full-Twilio-account cap. They cannot become surprise customer charges.
costModel.contingency: Rows also show10percent-of-revenue additional contingency, an internal budget assumption, not a tax determination. Tax treatment, merchant receipts and sustained account capacity remain actual precharge requirements.
costModel.firstPeriod: STANDARD61registration makes Coverage first-period contribution negative28.62planning/42.62stress; Follow-through50.87/10.87positive before extra contingency. Do not conceal the loss in amortization or assume retention. Recommend at most5initial shops with an explicit separately approved1000USDtotal company-funded launch/acquisition reserve, including registration, setup waiting costs, free-practice budget and early platform fixed costs. No spending is approved here.
costModel.operatingJudgment: This is a bounded pilot sensitivity, not validated profitable retail pricing or a60percent SaaS-margin claim. Proposed first-cohort floors of30percent planning/15percent stress before acquisition/tax/company overhead are met by these assumptions but are not owner-approved. Actual costs can invalidate them. Never cut public units or claim competitive value from these guesses; measure cost/quality, willingness to pay and full-use loss exposure first.
costModel.arithmeticVerification: Four full-use rows recomputed with Decimal; totals and contribution independently compared to exact Fraction sums. This checks arithmetic, not provider rates, attainable quotas or actual margins.

Test acceptance against an exact disclosed proposal and real customer job, then measure costs/support/renewal; no outreach or paid experiment is authorized here.

customerCopyProposal.coverage: Keep the calls you miss from becoming work you miss. Coverage gives your shop one place for calls, messages and visit requests.99USD/month with75phone minutes,50customer AI replies and150outgoing text parts.
customerCopyProposal.followthrough: Keep more service requests moving. Follow-through brings the same connected front desk with room for a steadier flow of customers.249USD/month with250phone minutes,150customer AI replies and450outgoing text parts.
customerCopyProposal.enterprise: A front desk designed around your operation. Tell us about your locations, call volume and systems. We will confirm the supported scope and a fixed proposal before you commit.
customerCopyProposal.start: Prepare your front desk free. Once the connections you choose pass their checks, review your complete monthly offer and start paid service when you are ready.
customerCopyProposal.renewal: Your subscription starts when payment succeeds and renews monthly on the date shown in Account. No timed trial starts during setup.
customerCopyProposal.cancel: Cancel renewal anytime in Account. Your paid service continues until the displayed period end unless you choose to stop it earlier. No further subscription payment follows confirmed cancellation; saved records and exports stay accessible under the retention policy.
customerCopyProposal.limit: No automatic overage charges. We show what remains and tell you before a limit is reached. At the limit, that service pauses new work until the next period; your saved requests remain available.
customerCopyProposal.refundProposal: Recommend no prorated refund for voluntary unused time, correction of erroneous charges, and a documented service-failure remedy. Final refund/tax/merchant disclosure must be approved in the service terms before any charge. Do not publish a money-back guarantee not operationally funded.
customerCopyProposal.copyHold: These words and new units are proposed review copy only. They do not replace current public pricing or become owner-approved entitlements.
customerCopyProposal.merchantStatementDisclosure: Your card statement may show ZARI MARKETING LLC.
customerCopyProposal.merchantDisclosureUse: Proposed sentence for the approved versioned offer.terms.text already shown in full before Checkout. Confirm actual LIVE merchant display first. This is not yet published or proof of the exact LIVE statement.
